# Part 1: EDA on the original data

```{r}
# Summarize the original data
summary(acupunc_full)
```

```{r}
# How many patients to each acupuncturist?

# calculate and print
patients_per_acu_full <- acupunc_full %>% 
  filter(group == "acupuncture") %>%  # consider only patients who received acupuncture
  group_by(acupuncturist) %>% summarize(n_patients = n())
patients_per_acu_full

# quantiles
quantile(patients_per_acu_full$n_patients)
```
12 total acupuncturists, ranging from 1 to 45 patients per acupuncturist.

```{r}
# How many patients to each GP?

# calculate and print
patients_per_gp_full <- acupunc_full %>% 
  group_by(gp) %>% summarize(n_patients = n())
patients_per_gp_full

# quantiles
quantile(patients_per_gp_full$n_patients)
```
36 total GPs, ranging from 1 to 43 patients per GP.

```{r}
# How many patients by sex and headache type?
acupunc_full %>% group_by(sex, migraine) %>% summarize(n())
```



# Part 2: Univariate analysis on the migraine-only data

## General summary
```{r}
# Summarize the data
summary(acupunc)
```

## Acupuncturist breakdown: numbers of patients and GPs
```{r}
# How many patients and GPs to each acupuncturist?
patients_per_acu <- acupunc %>% 
  
  # consider only patients who received acupuncture
  filter(group == "acupuncture") %>%  
  
  # first, get number of patients per acupuncturist/GP combination
  group_by(acupuncturist, gp) %>% 
  summarize(obs = n()) %>% 
  
  # then collapse to number of patients and number of GPs
  group_by(acupuncturist) %>% 
  summarize(n_patients = sum(obs), n_GPs = n())

# View results
patients_per_acu
```
```{r}
# Quantiles of n_patients per acupuncturist
quantile(patients_per_acu$n_patients)
```

```{r}
# Quantiles of n_GPs per acupuncturist
quantile(patients_per_acu$n_GPs)
```

12 total acupuncturists, ranging from 1 to 42 patients per acupuncturist and 1 to 5 GPs per acupuncturist.


## GP breakdown: numbers of patients (total and per group) and assigned acupuncturist
```{r}
# How many patients to each GP?
patients_per_gp <- acupunc %>% 
  group_by(gp, acupuncturist) %>% summarize(n_patients = n())

patients_per_gp

```
35 total GPs, ranging from 1 to 41 patients per GP.
